resources.string: Run shell commands right from chat
Start your message with ! and it runs in the shell of your project instead of going to the agent. The output shows up right in the conversation.
The message box gets the text !git status -s, a hint says it runs in the shell, and after sending, the command and its output appear in the chat.
Queue prompts and tweak them later
Prompts you queue while the agent is busy wait in a list above the message box. Send one now, edit it, or remove it before it runs.
Three queued prompts are listed. One is edited, one is removed, and one is sent right away and becomes a message.
See every file a session changed
Open Changes to review the files the agent touched, for the whole session or just the last turn. Tap a file to read its diff.
The Changes sheet lists two files with added and removed line counts. Tapping the first one opens its red and green diff.
Get pinged when the agent needs you
A notification tells you when a session waits for a permission or an answer, and when it finishes. You can allow or reject an edit right from it.
A notification asks for permission to edit a file and is answered with Allow once. Then a second notification says a session finished.
Connect your phone in seconds
Scan the QR code from opencode pair, paste the link, enter a password, or tap a server the app finds on your Wi-Fi.
On the Connect screen a server appears under Found on this network. Tapping Scan QR code opens the camera, reads a QR code and connects.
Watch the agent work, live
Text, reasoning and tool calls stream in as they happen. When the agent asks for a permission or a question, you answer right there.
A reply streams in with thinking and tool calls. A permission request appears and is approved with Allow once.
Steer, queue, and use / and @
Type / for commands and @ for files. While the agent works, choose to steer it right now or queue your prompt for later.
Typing / lists commands, typing @ lists files and one is picked. With the agent busy, Steer now and Queue buttons appear and Queue is chosen.
Fork a session from any prompt
Long-press a prompt and choose Fork from here to branch a new session with the history before it. The original stays untouched. Or just type /fork.
A long press on a prompt opens a menu; Fork from here is chosen and a new session opens without the later messages.
Undo and redo any prompt
Type /undo to take back the last prompt along with its file changes. Changed your mind? Tap Restore, or use /redo.
Typing /undo hides the last prompt and shows a banner saying 1 message undone. Tapping Restore brings it back.
